title: Community Engagement Officer - Part-time
description:
Community Engagement Officer

Oxted, Surrey 29,000 FTE (pro rata) 16 hours per week 12-month fixed-term contract

Are you an organised, personable and community-minded individual who enjoys bringing people together, building relationships and making a positive difference?

We are working with a well-established local charity to recruit a Community Engagement Officer to support an exciting community partnership initiative across East Surrey.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with experience in administration, event coordination and communications who would enjoy a varied role working with local charities, community groups and voluntary organisations.

The Opportunity

Working as part of a small, supportive team, you will help connect local communities, organisations and services, ensuring that people's voices, experiences and priorities are heard.

This is a varied, hands-on position combining community engagement, administration, event organisation and communications. You will attend local meetings and forums, develop relationships with community organisations, help coordinate events and workshops, and support the delivery of newsletters, website updates and social media content.

The role is office-based in Oxted when not attending meetings or events, with regular travel throughout East Surrey.

Key Responsibilities

Community Engagement & Relationship Building
- Attend community meetings, local forums and neighbourhood partnership events across East Surrey.
- Build and maintain positive relationships with voluntary organisations, community groups and local partners.
- Listen to local concerns, experiences and priorities, capturing key information and sharing insights with the wider partnership team.
- Maintain accurate records of meetings attended, contacts made and issues raised.

Administration & Coordination
- Organise meetings, manage invitations, coordinate attendance and maintain diaries and schedules.
- Keep contact databases, meeting notes, records and action logs up to date.
- Respond to routine enquiries and provide general administrative and coordination support.
- Liaise with partner organisations to support effective communication and day-to-day activities.

Events & Activities
- Assist with organising community events, workshops and partnership meetings.
- Coordinate venues, bookings, invitations, refreshments and event materials.
- Support event registration, on-the-day arrangements and post-event follow-up.

Communications & Social Media
- Help prepare and distribute newsletters and updates to community partners.
- Draft short website articles, news items, event notices and community updates.
- Create and schedule social media posts promoting activities, events and opportunities.
- Gather stories, photographs and information from meetings and events to support engaging communications.

About You

We are looking for someone who is approachable, proactive and highly organised, with the confidence to communicate with a wide range of people and manage a varied workload.

You will ideally have:
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a friendly and approachable manner.
- Previous experience in administration, meeting organisation or activity coordination.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities independently.
- The ability to take accurate meeting notes and produce clear, concise written summaries.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Outlook and Word.
- Confidence using newsletters, websites and social media to share information.
- A flexible and positive approach, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- A full driving licence and the ability to travel regularly throughout East Surrey.
- The ability to work from the Oxted office when not attending external meetings or events.

For your information:

Interested? Please send your CV in as a Word format only

Please only apply if you are already eligible to work in the UK (indefinitely & without sponsorship)

title: Head of External Affairs
company: Murray McIntosh Associates Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Murray McIntosh is proud to partner with Future Biogas, one of the UK's leading developers, owners and operators of anaerobic digestion and biomethane infrastructure. Operating 11 sites nationwide and backed by major infrastructure investors, the business is helping corporates decarbonise through renewable gas today while developing the next generation of carbon-negative energy projects.

As the business enters an exciting new phase of growth, Future Biogas is creating a Head of External Affairs role to strengthen its influence across government, regulators, industry and the wider stakeholder landscape.

This is a unique opportunity to establish and lead a new function at the centre of one of the UK's most innovative clean energy businesses.

The Opportunity

Working closely with the CEO and wider senior leadership, you will ensure Future Biogas is represented in the right conversations, building relationships that support both the business and the wider energy transition.

You'll sit at the intersection of policy, communications, business development and commercial strategy, helping to shape how Future Biogas engages with Government ministers and officials, regulators and policymakers, industry associations, corporate stakeholders and key partners across energy, agriculture and sustainability.

The role will operate with a high degree of autonomy, responsible for managing the external affairs function and associated budget.
- Lead the external affairs, development of FB's parliamentary profile and government stakeholder engagement activities.
- Create the relationships needed to help identify and influence policy developments across government, quasi-governmental organisations and NGO's that impact the business.
- Provide strategic advice on political and external affairs and reputational issues in conjunction with Policy, Comms and other FB teams as relevant.
- Support business development, planning and growth opportunities through effective stakeholder engagement.

We're interested in speaking with individuals who can demonstrate:
- Degree or equivalent experience in Public Affairs, Politics, Communications, Business or a related discipline
- Proven experience in public affairs, government relations or policy development within a related industry
- Excellent influencing, communication and stakeholder management skills
- Strong commercial awareness and strategic thinking
- Experience of leading and developing small, high-performing teams

Most importantly, you'll be a natural relationship-builder who enjoys opening doors, creating opportunities and bringing the right people together.

You'll combine strategic thinking with strong political awareness and have the credibility to engage confidently with senior stakeholders both internally and externally.

What's on Offer?
- A newly created leadership role with significant exposure to CEO and executive team and the opportunity to build and shape a function
- Competitive salary with performance-related bonus and excellent benefits package

Location: Future Biogas' headquarters are based in Guildford, with a new office opening within the Surrey Research Park. With a hybrid working model, the business already attracts talent from London and the South East, supported by strong rail links and shuttle transport.

If you're excited by the prospect of helping shape the future of renewable energy, carbon removals and UK sustainability policy, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Product Marketing Executive
description:
Product Marketing Executive

Hybrid (3 days Woking office, 2 days home based Software/SaaS/Healthtech

40,000 - 50,000 + Benefits

Are you a creative and data-driven B2 B product marketer looking to take ownership of product marketing initiatives in a global software business?

We are seeking a Product Marketing Executive to help drive awareness, lead generation, customer engagement and product adoption across a growing portfolio of software solutions. Working closely with Product Management, Sales and Marketing teams, you will play a key role in delivering go-to-market programmes, creating compelling messaging, managing campaigns and leveraging AI-powered marketing tools to improve performance and business outcomes.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious marketing professional who enjoys combining strategic thinking with hands-on campaign execution in a fast-paced software environment.

As Product Marketing Executive, you will:
- Execute product marketing campaigns aligned to product roadmaps and commercial objectives
- Support go-to-market initiatives for new product launches and enhancements
- Develop product messaging, positioning and value propositions
- Create sales enablement content, presentations, customer-facing materials and marketing collateral
- Drive demand generation activities and support lead nurturing programmes
- Monitor campaign performance, ROI, conversion rates and pipeline contribution
- Analyse marketing data and provide recommendations for continuous improvement
- Track market trends, customer needs and competitive activity
- Manage digital marketing assets and ensure content remains accurate and compliant
- Collaborate with Product, Sales and Marketing teams across international markets

AI-Enabled Marketing

A key aspect of this role is the practical application of AI within modern marketing operations. You will:
- Utilise AI tools to support content creation, audience targeting, campaign execution and optimisation
- Apply AI-driven approaches to lead scoring, segmentation and marketing efficiency
- Develop repeatable AI-assisted workflows to improve productivity and consistency
- Ensure AI-generated content aligns with brand standards, data privacy and compliance requirements
- Help promote AI best practices throughout the marketing organisation

You'll ideally have:
- 1-2 years' experience in B2 B software Product Marketing
- Practical experience with AI-driven marketing platforms and workflows or experience of using AI for market and competitve analysis, collateral support and lead gen
- Healthtech/healthcare sector experience
- Experience with one or more of HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce, Dynamics or similar marketing automation and crm products
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
- Excellent organisational and project management capabilities

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description:
This is a leadership role within a fast-growing social media and creator marketing agency, responsible for leading a team of Marketing Leads, driving performance across multiple digital platforms.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll take ownership of team performance, marketing operations, and strategic growth initiatives, ensuring high standards and consistent results across the department.

Client Details

A fast-growing digital agency operating across the UK and US, specialising in adult creator management, influencer marketing, and social media growth.

The business helps creators, influencers, and brands scale their online presence through marketing strategy, content optimisation, audience growth, and performance-driven campaigns across major social platforms.

Description

We're looking for an experienced Head of Marketing to lead and develop a high-performing social media marketing team.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll take ownership of the department's day-to-day operations, ensuring exceptional standards, strong team performance, and the successful delivery of marketing strategies across a portfolio of creators.

You'll manage and support a team of Marketing Leads, helping them drive creator growth, achieve key objectives, and maintain best practice across multiple social media platforms.

Working closely with your leadership team, you'll regularly review account performance, marketing activity, reporting, and overall team output to ensure consistent quality across the department.

You'll identify opportunities for improvement, provide coaching and feedback, and implement training initiatives to drive performance and development.

This is a hands-on leadership position suited to someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

You'll also lead key marketing projects, oversee the implementation of new systems and platforms, and help drive the continued growth and evolution of the business.

The successful candidate will be a strong people leader with excellent organisational skills, a passion for social media marketing, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high standards across a growing team.

Profile

Significant experience in social media marketing, digital marketing, or creator management.

Previous experience managing team leaders, managers, or a sizeable marketing team.

Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, X, YouTube, and other social platforms.

Proven ability to review account performance and identify practical areas for improvement.

Strong leadership skills with the ability to support, challenge, and hold managers accountable.

Experience delivering training, managing performance, and developing employees.

Confident working with social media analytics, KPIs, reporting, and performance data.

Ability to maintain high standards in a fast-paced and rapidly scaling business.

Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how social media growth contributes to creator revenue

Job Offer

45,000 - 50,000 with OTE of c. 60-65k.

This is a full on-site role.
